dek: Pharrell-produced album drops 10/2 with Tyler, JT, Future, and more.

slides.label: What Happened
slides.text: Quavo announced the full tracklist for his new album *QRÖMELIFE* on Friday, Sept. 25.

slides.label: The Producer
slides.text: The project is produced by *Pharrell*, who Quavo calls his 'big brother' for guiding him creatively.

slides.label: The Features
slides.text: Guests include *Tyler, The Creator, Justin Timberlake, Future, A$AP Rocky, Yung Miami*, TI, Offset, and Lil Baby.

slides.label: 14 Tracks
slides.text: The album runs 14 songs deep, from 'Backwards' to closer 'Destined.'

slides.label: The Story
slides.text: Quavo says the album was made last year while he was 'still dealing with grief' after *Takeoff's* 2022 death.

slides.label: In His Words
slides.text: 'Qromelife is about the journey of me going through tough times... and getting to the other side through my faith, family and love for music.'

slides.label: Release Date
slides.text: *QRÖMELIFE* drops October 2 via Quality Control Music/UMG. Pre-orders are open now.

slides.label: Why It Matters
slides.text: It's a real look at how *Black artists* turn grief into art, and keep building legacy on their own terms.

caption_instagram:
Quavo is turning pain into purpose. 

The Migos rapper just dropped the tracklist for his new album *QRÖMELIFE*, produced entirely by Pharrell and set to release October 2. The star-studded guest list includes Tyler, The Creator, Justin Timberlake, Future, A$AP Rocky, Yung Miami, TI, Offset, and Lil Baby. 

But this project is more than features. Quavo says he made it last year while still grieving the loss of Takeoff, calling it a journey through 'faith, family and my love for music.' He credits Pharrell with pushing him creatively during a hard time. 

This is what healing through art looks like, real and public.
